description: Composite dataset-gallery figure: 11 bordered cards arranged in three colour-coded rows, plus a legend panel at bottom right. Each card pairs a micrograph thumbnail (left) with, at right, the dataset name and modality in parentheses, the microstructure class, the "real size" field of view in µm, the pixel resolution, and a coloured banner naming the material and imaged feature. Blue top row ("Polycrystalline & Single phase"): PI-1 (OM) pure iron (ferrite), 1024*1024 µm / 1024*1024 pix; SS (OM) AlFe stainless steel (austenite), 247*247 µm / 1024*1024 pix; HEA (OM) FeCoCrNiMn high-entropy alloy, 604.98*403.90 µm / 5530*3692 pix; LCS (OM) low carbon steel, size field blank ("------"), 1360*600 pix. Green middle row ("Polycrystalline & Multiphase"): PI-2 (OM) pure iron, 2560*1920 pix; DP590-1 (SEM) dual-phase steel (hot-rolled, martensite), 36.56*36.56 µm / 512*512 pix; DP590-2 (SEM) dual-phase steel (cold-rolled, martensite), 56.93*42.70 µm / 1024*768 pix; AZA (XCT) AlZn alloy (dendrite), 1380*1380 µm / 852*852 pix. Light-yellow bottom row ("Single crystal & Multiphase"): NBS-1 and NBS-2 (SEM) nickel-based superalloy (precipitate), both 512*512 pix; UHCS (SEM) ultrahigh carbon steel (cementite), 768*768 pix. Legend maps blue/green/light-yellow to the three microstructure classes and solid/dashed borders to public/in-house datasets, demonstrating the cross-modality morphological diversity on which MatSAM is evaluated.

observations.observation: The figure is a gallery of 11 microscopy dataset cards grouped into three rows by microstructure class, each card giving a thumbnail, dataset name with modality, microstructure type, real size in µm and pixel resolution.
The legend assigns blue background to 'Polycrystalline & Single phase', green to 'Polycrystalline & Multiphase', and light yellow to 'Single crystal & Multiphase'.
The legend distinguishes datasets by border style: solid border = 'Public dataset', dashed border = 'In-house dataset'.
Card PI-1 (OM) is labelled Polycrystalline / Single phase, 'pure iron (ferrite)', real size 1024*1024 (µm), 1024*1024 (pix).
Card SS (OM) is labelled 'AlFe stainless steel (austenite)', real size 247*247 (µm), 1024*1024 (pix); its illumination is visibly uneven.
Card HEA (OM) is labelled 'FeCoCrNiMn high-entropy alloy', Polycrystalline / Single phase, real size 604.98*403.90 (µm), 5530*3692 (pix).
Card DP590-2 (SEM) is labelled 'dual-phase steel (cold-rolled, martensite)', real size 56.93*42.70 (µm), 1024*768 (pix).
Card AZA (XCT) is labelled 'AlZn alloy (dendrite)', Polycrystalline / Multiphase, real size 1380*1380 (µm), 852*852 (pix).
The NBS-1, NBS-2, UHCS, LCS and PI-2 cards all leave the 'real size' field blank ('------'), giving only the pixel resolution.

The caption states the figure shows 11 curated microscopy datasets, five public (solid border) and six in-house (dashed border), classified as polycrystalline & single-phase, polycrystalline & multiphase, and single crystal & multiphase.
The citing text states PI-1/2, SS, HEA and LCS images were captured using OM; DP590-1/2, NBS-1/2 and UHCS using SEM; and AZA using XCT.
The citing text states the five public datasets are AZA, NBS-1/2, UHCS and LCS, while all in-house datasets carry manual annotations.
The citing text states uneven micrograph quality from unstable light or imaging conditions is visible in the SS and PI-2 images of Fig. 1.

The citing text states DP590-1 contains 23 hot-rolled martensitic precipitate images of relatively low definition with low-gray precipitates contoured by black boundaries, whereas DP590-2 martensite appears as light white streaks.
